mapper.select: SELECT id, type, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, read_flag, create_time FROM user_notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_flag = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM user_notification WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_notification SET read_flag = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND read_flag = 0
UPDATE user_notification SET read_flag = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_flag = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notification (user_id, type, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, read_flag, create_time) SELECT id, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, 0, NOW() FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1

INSERT INTO user_notification (user_id, type, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, read_flag, create_time) SELECT id, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, 0, NOW() FROM sys_user WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND role = 'DOCTOR' AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1

INSERT INTO user_notification (user_id, type, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, read_flag, create_time) SELECT u.id, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, 'appointment', #{appointmentId}, 0, NOW() FROM sys_user u JOIN schedule s ON s.doctor_id = u.doctor_id JOIN appointment a ON a.schedule_id = s.id WHERE a.id = #{appointmentId} AND u.role = 'DOCTOR' AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1

INSERT INTO user_notification (user_id, type, title, content, biz_type, biz_id, read_flag, create_time) SELECT u.id, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, 'prescription', #{prescriptionId}, 0, NOW() FROM sys_user u JOIN doctor d ON d.id = u.doctor_id JOIN department dep ON dep.id = d.department_id WHERE u.role = 'PHARMACIST' AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND d.role_type = 'PHARMACIST' AND d.status = 1 AND dep.type = 'PHARMACY' AND dep.status = 1
